summary: This directory centralizes the configuration interfaces and option definitions used to control the execution, retry behavior, and analysis parameters of the system. It serves as a unified source for defining how various tasks are configured and monitored during operation.
responsibilities: Defining schema and configuration structures for AI and analysis tasks
Managing execution-wide settings and operational flags
Providing hooks for monitoring and observing retry attempts
relationships: Execution options serve as the base configuration from which AI and analysis options extend their specific functional parameters.
The retry option integrates with retry observers to allow external components to hook into and monitor automated retry lifecycle events.
designDecisions: Inheritance-based interface extension to share common execution properties across different domain options
Composition of observability patterns to decouple retry logic from monitoring implementation
